name: Scotland Highlands Farm + Estate Loop

dates.why: Aug 31-Sep 13 keeps the Edinburgh nonstop pattern, lands Sep 1, and shortens the expensive estate-hotel exposure by using practical inns/cottages as the default.

exchangeRateNote: Foreign-currency items use planning conversions and must be re-priced before booking.
positioning: Budget-rebalanced Scotland Highlands loop: Edinburgh apartments, Perthshire/Trossachs inns, and Braemar cottages by default, with Gleneagles and Fife Arms as named splurge options.
routeLabel: Edinburgh → Gleneagles → Trossachs farm → Braemar → Edinburgh
routeRationale: The route is ordered as Edinburgh → Gleneagles → Trossachs farm → Braemar → Edinburgh to reduce backtracking and keep the biggest transfers between lodging bases.
Each base lasts 2-4 nights so the baby has repeated sleep environments instead of daily hotel churn.
High-impact sights are paired with nearby backup options so weather does not break the trip.
The Ryan Shirley/video inspiration is used for idea generation, then validated with official tourism, park, hotel, airline, and activity sources.

budget.note: Reworked close to target by moving Gleneagles/Fife Arms from default lodging into optional splurge swaps.
